title: 18-Year-Old Goes Nuts On Police After Assaulting Parole Officer
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On February 16th, 2023. Officers were called to an emergency center regarding an 18-year-old that had a warrant for her arrest. When the officers arrived she was not compliant and immediately started giving the officers a tough time, she had to be taken to the ground and  placed in cuffs. She continued to display this behaviour until she was taken to the squad car. The warrant she had was for assault on her parole officer. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
